Rocco Acocella , Italian teacher and creativity researcher in Milan

Italian teacher at the Canadian School of Milan, and a workshop leader who trains teachers and students to switch attention on purpose.

See the workshops Write to Rocco
Teaching Workshops Talks Training

Approach

Language is how ideas move between people. Rocco teaches Italian, and teaches people to move their attention on purpose.

His work joins developmental and cognitive psychology, collaboration and creative process, with ideas borrowed from quantum physics, to make learning personal. In class it runs on one design cycle, The EduDesign Alchemist.

  3. CCultivate

Projects and skills

Creative, critical, lateral and non-linear thinking, workshop design and leadership, team dynamics, personalised learning, mental imagery, visual conceptualisation, AI tools in practice, public speaking, classroom management, problem solving, lesson planning.

LEGOciation

Negotiating ideas through building. Groups talk, build in LEGO, and rebuild, so thinking becomes something they can hold. Used from MYP classrooms to teacher conferences.

Shape Your Brain

An activity where students picture neural growth as their answer to a hard task: a working metaphor for how challenge changes the brain.

The attention card deck

A facilitation deck that prompts deliberate switches of attention, built for the alternating-attention workshop at the Italian Summit 2026.

PSN hubs

Small local gatherings that carry the Possibility Studies Network between conferences, developed in Productive Friction and the Mission Possible poster.

Every workshop

Thirteen workshops since 2023, for 349 counted participants: teachers, student teachers and students.

23 October 2026

Vienna

Multilingualism and Attention Alternation: Creative-Cerebral Strategies

World Languages Conference 2026, American International School of Vienna. In person, headcount not recorded.

How multilingualism and switching attention lift learning and group creativity. Participants used languages, gestures and cultural perspectives as a creative method, moving between divergent and convergent modes, and left with practical strategies for innovation and collaborative learning.

19 June 2026

Online

Chromasoma: Minds, Memories, Morphing, and Surfacing Collective Intuition

Possibility Studies Network. Online, headcount not recorded.

An experimental collaborative workshop combining body mapping, visual scoring, quantum-inspired tools and AI-assisted creation. Colour became a rhizomatic space for surfacing memories, sensations, intuitions and rhythms, which were turned into a shared animated visual field: a collective prelude to the conference.

8 May 2026

Chieri, Turin

Alternating Attention as a Catalyst for a Creative-Cerebral Educational Perspective

Italian Summit 2026, International School of Turin. 1 hour, 48 IB teachers.

Teachers played through an alternate scenario at the meeting point of creative cognition, play, sense-making and collaboration. Experiential activities used transdisciplinary materials and systemic thinking, and a facilitating card deck trained deliberate attention-shifting and metacognitive awareness for cognitive and temporal flexibility.

21 March 2026

Milan

Idea Bouncing: Building the Future through Vibrational LEGOciation

MITA 2026, American School of Milan. 1 hour, 14 teachers.

Language, communication and creative cognition in practice. Linguistic interaction and collaborative problem-solving, with deliberate attention-shifting, turned abstract ideas into built, tangible outcomes, showing how dialogue mediates creativity and learning design.

19 January 2026

Online

Productive Friction: Creative Freedom in Times of Political Contestation

5th Virtual Conference of the Possibility Studies Network. 2 hours, online, 30 participants.

What happens to a creative community once its annual conference ends? Participants designed local PSN hubs, small events that carry the network into their own places, to keep connection alive and ease everyday tension through shared creative work.

7 January 2026

Milan

Idea Bouncing: Building the Future through Vibrational LEGOciation

Canadian School of Milan. 1 hour, 25 teachers.

The in-house edition of Idea Bouncing for colleagues: linguistic interaction, collaborative building and deliberate attention-shifting to move ideas from abstract to tangible.

24 October 2025

Basel

From Idea to Creation: A Creative-Cerebral Perspective for Language Education

2nd Annual World Languages Conference, International School of Basel. 1 hour 20 minutes, 15 teachers.

Experiential activities for language teachers on how communication and language act as mediators of creativity, using structured collaboration and metacognitive awareness to turn ideas into purposeful learning design.

6 June 2025

Rome

IB Learner Profile Thinker: Una prospettiva creativo-cerebrale per la didattica dell’italiano e oltre!

Italian Summit 2025, Marymount International School Rome. 2 hours, 70 IB teachers.

The IB Learner Profile attribute Thinker seen through creativity and cognitive neuroscience. Educators reflected on their own teaching approaches and cognitive styles, and explored brain-based learning and strategies that bring creative thinking into the Learner Profile.

January to February 2025

Milan

R(AI)sing Awareness in the Pl(AI)ground

Canadian School of Milan. 4.5 hours over three sessions, 25 teachers.

Staff training on artificial intelligence: prompt frameworks in ChatGPT for lesson plans, assessments, reports and creative tasks, and hands-on use of NotebookLM, Napkin AI, Gamma, Revoldiv and NoteGPT for designing teaching content.

October 2024

Milan

The Thinking Journey

Canadian School of Milan. 2 hours, 80 MYP students.

Students explored how the brain works while building critical thinking. In Shape Your Brain they pictured neural growth as a response to challenge; in LEGOciation at the Station they rotated through nine thematic stations of dialogue and LEGO construction, closing with reflection on high-quality thinking.

October 2024

Reykjavík

Creative Mindset and Language Learning

University of Iceland. 2 hours, online, 14 pre-service teachers.

Growth mindset meets creative thinking for future language teachers: creativity and neuroplasticity in theory, then Random Word, Random Picture, Reverse Brainstorming and Six Thinking Hats in practice.

February to April 2024

Milan

Human Rights, Emotions & the Brain: a Transversal Bridge between Past and Future

Canadian School of Milan. 12 sessions, 14 MYP3 students.

A series on creativity, change and perspective within personal and cultural expression and fairness and development. Memory, thinking strategies, emotions and brain function were explored through Memory, LEGO and jigsaw games, and students presented on human rights, memory, emotional intelligence and divergent thinking.

March to April 2023

Reykjavík

The Creative Mindset Journey

University of Iceland, Reykjavík. 8 hours in person, 14 pre-service teachers.

In-person sessions joining growth mindset with creative thinking methods to build future teachers’ creative dispositions. Participants reported more confidence, engagement and enthusiasm for using creative strategies in their teaching.
